title: 3191. Minimum Operations to Make Binary Array Elements Equal to One I

examples.explanation: We can do the following operations: Choose the elements at indices 0, 1 and 2. The resulting array is nums = [1,0,0,1,0,0]. Choose the elements at indices 1, 2 and 3. The resulting array is nums = [1,1,1,0,0,0]. Choose the elements at indices 3, 4 and 5. The resulting array is nums = [1,1,1,1,1,1].
It is impossible to make all elements equal to 1.
